outcome: time between labor induction and start of active phase
duration of active phase of second stage of childbirth
cohort: 172 primiparous women, in or before the 40th week of pregnancy, with Bishop scores of 4 or lower, excluding those with diabetes, preeclampsia, macrosomia, twin pregnancy, rupture of membranes, breech presentation, or background diseases.
finding: Intravenous Dexamethasone significantly improved the Bishop score of the cervix and reduced the time between labor induction and the start of the active phase of childbirth.
gest_age: In or before the 40th week of pregnancy
